image_description: A handmade patchwork baby bib featuring squares of green, yellow, and pink floral fabrics. It has a central vertical strip of solid teal fabric with an embroidered pocket depicting a stylized face or character. The neck closure consists of white elastic loops tied in a bow at the top. The bib is laid flat on a neutral beige textured surface.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a bib and distinguish it from other garments like aprons or vests.
To verify the structural integrity of the patchwork seams and ensure the ties are physically connected to the main body without fusion artifacts.
To check for subtle texture inconsistencies in the fabric patterns and stitching details that might indicate AI generation.

focus_areas: Connection points of the white ties to the main body
Consistency of stitching lines between patchwork squares
Clarity and logic of the embroidered pocket design
Texture uniformity across different fabric patches
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the white ties at the top; AI often struggles with rendering thin, overlapping strings or elastics correctly. Check if the ties merge into the background or the bib body unnaturally. Also, inspect the patchwork seams for 'melting' where colors blend without a clear stitch line.
